title: Congress MLA Alleges IPS Officer Influenced Datia Bypoll
summary: Congress MLA Ghanshyam Singh has accused IPS officer Dr. Asit Yadav of attempting to influence the Datia by-election. Singh specifically named Dr. Yadav, describing him as a "strict IPS officer." The allegations were made in relation to the Datia by-election results. The coverage does not specify the nature of the alleged influence or the outcome of the by-election.
summary_points: Congress MLA Ghanshyam Singh accused IPS officer Dr. Asit Yadav of influencing the Datia by-election.
Dr. Asit Yadav was described as a "strict IPS officer" by the MLA.
The allegations were made in connection with the Datia by-election.
The specific details of the alleged influence were not provided in the coverage.

summary_hi: कांग्रेस विधायक घनश्याम सिंह ने IPS अधिकारी डॉ. असित यादव पर दतिया उपचुनाव को प्रभावित करने की कोशिश करने का आरोप लगाया है। सिंह ने विशेष रूप से डॉ. यादव का नाम लिया, जिन्हें उन्होंने "कड़क IPS अफसर" बताया। ये आरोप दतिया उपचुनाव के नतीजों के संबंध में लगाए गए थे। कवरेज में कथित प्रभाव की प्रकृति या उपचुनाव के परिणाम के बारे में कोई जानकारी नहीं दी गई है।
